description: This Java source file defines the MediaIDHelper utility class, which provides methods for creating, parsing, and manipulating media IDs used in a media browsing application to organize media content hierarchically.

classes.name: MediaIDHelper
classes.description: Utility class to manage media identifiers for browsing and playback.

methods.name: createMediaID
methods.description: Constructs a media ID string from a music ID and optional categories, formatted for hierarchical organization.

methods.name: createBrowseCategoryMediaID
methods.description: Creates a media ID string for a specific browse category based on category type and value.

methods.name: extractMusicIDFromMediaID
methods.description: Extracts and returns the musicID component from a mediaID string.

methods.name: getHierarchy
methods.description: Splits a mediaID into its hierarchical components, excluding the musicID.

methods.name: extractBrowseCategoryValueFromMediaID
methods.description: Retrieves the category value from a mediaID representing a browse category.

methods.name: getParentMediaID
methods.description: Returns the parent media ID of a given mediaID, moving up one level in hierarchy.
